scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.test:quotes: pnpm --filter @workspace/quote-mail test && pnpm --filter @workspace/quote-mail exec tsx --test ../../api/quote.test.ts ../../artifacts/sergerie-website/scripts/analytics.test.ts && node --test artifacts/sergerie-website/tests/quote-form-model.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck && tsc -p api/tsconfig.json
